title: Dog on Bicycle
description: A small orange and white dog with big upright ears and a blue collar looks directly at the viewer while sitting on a bicycle. Its front paws rest on the handlebars against a simple painted background of beige, gray, and orange tones.
prompt: A small orange and white dog with large upright ears, black eyes, and a blue collar with a round tag sits on a bicycle and looks straight at the viewer. The dog rests both front paws on the silver handlebars with brown grips. The background is an abstract painted wall in beige gray and orange brush strokes. Simple realistic style with visible brush textures.
